translations.web: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
translations.bsb: The LORD uprooted them from their land in His anger, rage, and great wrath, and He cast them into another land, where they are today.’
translations.kjv: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
translations.asv: and Jehovah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as at this day.
